teamNews.text: Brentford · Igor Thiago is suspended. Hickey, Collins and Rico Henry are out. Fábio Carvalho could return to the squad.
Everton · The pre-match availability report lists no injuries or suspensions. Barry is projected to start up front.
Levante · Romero is in contention to return to the XI. Previews differ on Manu Sánchez’s availability.
Elche · Marc Aguado and Yago Santiago are out. Lemar is back in contention, with his starting role uncertain.
St. Louis CITY SC · Holse and Pompeu are out. Bürki is a doubt, with Lundt a projected replacement.
LAFC · LAFC expects Lloris to be available, but the starting goalkeeper is uncertain after he missed the regular-season finale.
Monza · Maye and Folorunsho are out. Pessina and Ziólkowski are in contention to start.
Fiorentina · Parisi and Pongračić are out. Njie is a fitness doubt, with Gnonto an option if he cannot start.
Istanbul Basaksehir · Yusuf Sarı, Operi and Fayzullaev are still receiving treatment. Selke is projected to lead the line.
Çorum FK · Berat Özdemir is out. Several attacking spots differ across the available projected XIs.
